name: studybridge
description: For tutors: Claude reads your learners’ work and progress in StudyBridge and drafts assignments, marking and messages for you to approve.
long_description: StudyBridge is a private tutoring portal. With this connector, Claude can see your learners, their submissions (including maths working and photos of their work), their progress, and the PDFs in your library. Claude can draft assignments, suggested marking with explanations, lessons and messages. Everything Claude makes is saved as a draft in StudyBridge → From Claude, and reaches a learner only after you approve it. Learners never use Claude.

prompts.name: mark_latest
prompts.text: Using StudyBridge, look at the submissions waiting to be marked. For each one, read it carefully, then draft marks with clear explanations of any mistakes, and flag questions worth a redo.

prompts.name: weekly_report
prompts.text: Using StudyBridge, write me a short weekly report on each learner: time studied, work handed in, scores, strengths, topics that need work, and what to set next.
